text: Janto an Nulaaɗo, tuma nde Ibraahiimaa (yo o his) maakannoo ben makko Aazara sirkaynooɗo : "Enee Baaba ! E a jogitoto sanamuuji reweteeɗi maa gaanin Alla?!" Pellet, min miɗo yi'e an e yimɓe maa rewooɓe sanamu ɓen, e nde rmajjere ɓanngunde!" Ko Seniiɗo On tun hanndi e reweede, ko heddii kon fow ko meere.
